items.definition:
a small, onion-like plant used as a culinary herb
I chopped some fresh chives to sprinkle over the soup.

a brush used for applying paint
She dipped her paintbrush into the blue paint and began to color the canvas.

a storm with heavy rain
A sudden rainstorm caught us by surprise.

a night of a weekday
We usually have a quiet dinner on a weeknight.

a Spanish title of respect for a man, equivalent to Mr.
"Excuse me, Senor," she said, trying to get his attention.

a car for hire with a driver
We took a taxicab to the airport.

anywhere
You can sit anyplace you like.

an area or building where cars may be parked
We left our car in the carpark near the station.

an adult
The children were told to act like grown-ups.

a person whose job is to repair things
The repairman fixed our washing machine.

device for measuring time
He used a stopwatch to time the runners.

a toy consisting of a pair of discs joined by an axle
He learned to do tricks with his new yoyo.

The act of registering arrival at a hotel or airport.
The checkin desk is located on the ground floor.

leavened flatbread
We ordered chicken curry with a side of naan bread.

stall selling newspapers and magazines
I bought a magazine from the newsstand at the station.

a car designed for racing
The racecar sped around the track.

a small shelter for a dog
The dog slept in its doghouse.

A container for household rubbish; a trash can.
Please put the empty packaging in the dustbin.

a large, thick-skinned African mammal
The hippopotamus spent most of its day submerged in the river.

a bee that produces honey
A honeybee buzzed around the flowers in the garden.

father (informal)
My poppa always tells the best stories before bedtime.

an exercise performed by lying face down and pushing up with the arms
She does twenty pushups every morning as part of her fitness routine.

a string or cord used to tie shoes
My shoelace came undone, and I almost tripped.

a burrowing annelid worm that lives in the soil
After the rain, many earthworms appeared on the sidewalk.
